text.p: U.S. investment bank Goldman Sachs Research warmly recommended second biggest Danish bank Unidanmark in its latest European Banks Fact Sheet received by Reuters on Monday.

It said Unidanmark was one of its favourites in the Scandinavian bank sector, which had some of the best capitalised banks in Europe, following efforts to recapitalise the sector during the crisis years of the early 1990s.
"In our view Danish banks have both healthy capital bases and plenty of unrealised excess loan reserves to leverage," Goldman Sachs wrote.
It said its price target for Unidanmark, which is on its recommended list, was 440 to 480 crowns per share.
The Unidanmark share traded two crowns down at 420 crowns at 1010 GMT on Monday. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
